facts.business: Prism Johnson Limited is a diversified building materials company with established brands and strong market positions across Cement, Tiles and Bathware (H & R Johnson), Ready-Mix Concrete (Prism RMC), and General Insurance (Raheja QBE).
facts.related_party_note: The Company has a policy for related party transactions. The schedule of related party transactions during the year and balances at year-end were obtained and read. Minutes of the audit committee meeting where such related party transactions have been pre-approved were also reviewed.
